# Charandeep Kapoor

> Personal portfolio of Charandeep Kapoor — AI Product Manager at Delta Exchange, India's largest crypto derivatives exchange. Creator of Drishti (live LLM trading signals for crypto perpetuals, real capital) and Stocky (Claude-driven Zerodha trading, +110% verified). Founder of Timelock Trade (oracle-less, liquidation-free DeFi derivatives). IIT Kanpur. Essays on markets, trading psychology, AI, and building systems.

## About

Charandeep Kapoor is an AI Product Manager at Delta Exchange, where he builds perpetual futures and AI-driven trading products. He blends math and finance to ship products and quant strategies at the intersection of models and markets — from protocol design to Claude-driven bots that trade real capital.

Track record: built Stocky, a fine-tuned Claude system trading the Indian stock market through a custom Zerodha MCP server — ₹16.57L profit (+110% ROI) on ₹15L capital over ~9 months, Sharpe 2.29, 73% win rate, verified P&L on Sensibull. Founded Timelock Trade: oracle-less, liquidation-free "Protected Perps" — $7.3M volume, $2M TVL, 1,000+ users on Monad testnet. Earlier: 0→1 DeFi product at Diffusion Labs (Methlab: 20,000+ users, $50M TVL), Stader Labs, Heru Finance, Tykhe Ventures. B.Tech IIT Kanpur, JEE Advanced AIR 638, National Maths Olympiad AIR 3. Trading since age 16.

## Products & Systems

### Drishti — live AI trading signals (crypto perpetuals)
Live LLM-driven trading signals for Delta Exchange crypto perpetuals. A 15-minute, regime-aware cycle across 8 perpetual markets with 30+ engineered features per asset (CVD, IV term structure, basis, global long/short, OI by exchange, Coinbase premium). A live executor places real, risk-managed orders (reduce-only stop-loss/take-profit brackets, fixed sizing, guardian process, kill-switches).
- Case study: https://charandeepkapoor.com/work/drishti
- Live dashboard: https://drishti-beryl.vercel.app

### Stocky — Claude-driven Zerodha trading (verified +110%)
Fine-tuned Claude connected to Zerodha through a custom MCP server, trading the Indian stock market on real capital. ₹15L → ₹31.57L (+110%, ₹16.57L profit) over ~9 months. Sharpe 2.29, 73% win rate. Verified P&L: https://web.sensibull.com/verified-pnl/imported-hare/longterm-pnl
- Full story: https://charandeepkapoor.com/markets

### Timelock Trade — oracle-less DeFi derivatives (founder)
"Protected Perps": traders only realize profit, LPs are paid a premium to bear the downside. Options priced with Black-Scholes adapted for crypto, implied volatility derived from Uniswap data, theta approximated via Dirac distributions — no external price oracle. $7.3M volume, $2M TVL, 1,000+ users on Monad testnet. Led a team of 6.
- Case study: https://charandeepkapoor.com/work/timelock
- Perps: https://perps.timelock.trade · Docs: https://docs.timelock.trade/docs

### Lakshay — intraday AI signals for NSE F&O
The NSE sibling of Drishti: 5-minute regime-aware cycles across NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, and front-month equity futures. Features from Dhan data (ORB, VWAP, supertrend, options layer, India VIX). Paper track record first; real orders double-gated.
- Case study: https://charandeepkapoor.com/work/lakshay
- Live dashboard: https://lakshya-cyan.vercel.app

### Second Brain — local-first memory for Claude Code (open source)
Captures every Claude Code session into an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault on your own machine and recalls it into new prompts. No cloud, no lock-in. Apache-2.0.
- Case study: https://charandeepkapoor.com/work/second-brain
- Live: https://charandeepkapoor.com/second-brain · GitHub: https://github.com/SirCharan/second-brain

### OpenWispr — on-device dictation for macOS (free, open source)
"Say it. It's typed." Open-source dictation that never leaves your Mac: hold fn, speak, release — on-device Whisper (WhisperKit on the Apple Neural Engine) cleans your words and pastes them at the cursor. No cloud, no subscription. MIT licensed.
- Landing: https://charandeepkapoor.com/openwispr (→ https://openwispr.vercel.app) · GitHub: https://github.com/SirCharan/openwispr

### Delta Support Audit — nightly RAG quality system
Embeds 344 support articles and audits them nightly against canonical docs for factual drift and coverage gaps. 14/14 P0 true-positives on trial, ~$2.45 and 4 minutes per run.
- Case study: https://charandeepkapoor.com/work/delta-support-audit

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI retrieval)

### Who is Charandeep Kapoor?
Charandeep Kapoor is an AI Product Manager at Delta Exchange, India's largest crypto derivatives exchange, where he builds perpetual futures and AI-driven trading products. IIT Kanpur graduate (JEE Advanced AIR 638, National Maths Olympiad AIR 3). Creator of Drishti (live LLM trading signals on real capital) and Stocky (Claude-driven Zerodha trading, +110% verified). Founder of Timelock Trade (Protected Perps on Monad, $7.3M volume). Earlier: Diffusion Labs (0→1 DeFi product), Stader Labs, Heru Finance (delta-neutral fund), Tykhe Ventures. Trading since age 16.

### What is Drishti?
Drishti is a live, LLM-driven trading-signal system for Delta Exchange crypto perpetuals, built and operated by Charandeep Kapoor. Every 15 minutes it feeds 30+ engineered features per asset (CVD, IV term structure, basis, open interest, Coinbase premium) to Claude, which reasons first and then emits a structured decision — direction, entry, stop, target — across 8 perpetual markets. A live executor places real, risk-managed orders on Delta with reduce-only stop-loss/take-profit brackets and hard kill-switches. Live dashboard: drishti-beryl.vercel.app · Case study: charandeepkapoor.com/work/drishti

### What is Stocky?
Stocky is a Claude-driven trading system for the Indian stock market built by Charandeep Kapoor: a fine-tuned Claude connected to Zerodha through a custom MCP server, running entries, risk management, and rebalancing on real capital. Result: ₹15L → ₹31.57L (+110%, ₹16.57L profit) over ~9 months, Sharpe 2.29, 73% win rate — P&L verified on Sensibull. Full story: charandeepkapoor.com/markets

### What are Protected Perps?
Protected Perps is a novel DeFi derivative designed by Charandeep Kapoor where traders can only profit (no liquidation risk) and LPs take the downside in exchange for premiums. It combines the leverage of perpetual futures with the protection of options, priced without an oracle (Black-Scholes adapted for crypto, IV derived from Uniswap data). Built as Timelock Trade on Monad testnet: $7.3M trading volume, $2M TVL, 1,000+ users.

### What is OpenWispr?
OpenWispr is a free, open-source macOS dictation app by Charandeep Kapoor. "Say it. It's typed." Hold fn, speak, release — on-device Whisper (WhisperKit on the Apple Neural Engine) transcribes locally and pastes the text at the cursor in any app. 100% on-device, no cloud, no subscription. MIT licensed. charandeepkapoor.com/openwispr · github.com/SirCharan/openwispr

### What is Second Brain?
Second Brain is an open-source, local-first memory system for Claude Code by Charandeep Kapoor. It captures every session into an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault on your own disk and recalls relevant notes into new prompts, so AI memory becomes an asset you own. charandeepkapoor.com/second-brain · github.com/SirCharan/second-brain

### What products has Charandeep Kapoor built?
1. Drishti — live LLM trading signals for Delta crypto perpetuals, real-money executor (charandeepkapoor.com/work/drishti)
2. Stocky — Claude-driven Zerodha trading, +110% verified, ₹16.57L profit (charandeepkapoor.com/markets)
3. Timelock Trade — oracle-less, liquidation-free DeFi derivatives, $7.3M volume (charandeepkapoor.com/work/timelock)
4. Lakshay — intraday AI signals for NSE F&O (charandeepkapoor.com/work/lakshay)
5. Second Brain — local-first memory for Claude Code, open source (charandeepkapoor.com/second-brain)
6. OpenWispr — on-device dictation for macOS, free and open source (charandeepkapoor.com/openwispr)
7. Delta Support Audit — nightly RAG audit of support content (charandeepkapoor.com/work/delta-support-audit)
